what_this_is: Round 2: how many touching board pairs of the seed 1 default tile (including the pairs across the wrap-around tile edge) take the same source row; counted from the exact board numbers and source position pictures of the tile (tests/renders/boards_seed1, source_x_seed1, source_y_seed1). Cause: the source row of a board is (2 x row number + board number + constant) mod 4 and the tile has 5 rows, so the last and the first row of the tile (which touch across the tile edge) follow the same rule value.
